## Analysis

My COMP110 improvement idea:

    **The course should add an extra credit assignment at the end of the year where students turn in their handwritten notes because it would encourage active listening in class and reduce TA workload.**

This idea could potentially both increase in-class engagement for students and reduce TA workload concerning assisting confused students.

After importing all relevant functions from data_utils.py, I converted all the raw data I needed for my data analysis into a select few useable columns. Then, I wrangled my data further into ints so seaborn could use it to produce graphs, and I used my dataset to gather simple info for Figure 1, my histogram.
